text:
Maya: quick check on SDK retry defaults for handling 429 / 5xx — want to standardize across python/node/java so app teams get predictable behavior.
Sam: we have notes but no single canonical defaults. propose: respect Retry-After header, use exponential backoff with full jitter, cap attempts by default.
Kevin: +1. Infra practical defaults I use: base=500ms, factor=2, cap=8000ms, max_attempts=5. Also opt out of automatic retries for streaming endpoints by default.
Jordana: streaming nuance: never auto-retry mid-stream unless the stream is resumable. For non-resumable streams SDK should surface ERR_STREAM_INTERRUPTED and let the app decide.
Maya: about idempotency tokens — should SDK auto-generate Idempotency-Key for POSTs? or keep opt-in?
Sam: I recommend opt-in helper: provide with_idempotency() that generates a UUID and reuses it across retries. Auto-attaching could change semantics for rare non-idempotent operations.
Kevin: server behavior: our endpoints honor Idempotency-Key and will return prior result on duplicate. So client retries must reuse the same token.
Jordana: 429 vs 5xx handling: if Retry-After present, sleep exactly that many seconds before retry. If not, fall back to backoff+jitter. For 5xx use backoff+jitter and fewer attempts (e.g., 4).
Maya: can we include short pseudo-code to show full-jitter calculation? will add to SDK READMEs.
Sam: happy to. Common pattern (full jitter):
```
base = 0.5  # seconds
cap = 8.0
max_attempts = 5
attempt = 0
while attempt < max_attempts:
    if resp and resp.status == 429 and 'Retry-After' in resp.headers:
        sleep_seconds(int(resp.headers['Retry-After']))
    else:
        temp = min(cap, base * (2 ** attempt))
        sleep = random.uniform(0, temp)  # full jitter
        sleep_seconds(sleep)
    resp = do_request()
    if resp.ok:
        break
    attempt += 1
```
Kevin: small implementation notes: honor Retry-After before applying jitter. If Retry-After is very large (>60s) consider surfacing to user instead of blocking in SDK.
Jordana: streaming again: if a stream returns 502 mid-stream don't replay. Provide an explicit error and a helper that can buffer+retry only when callers opt into idempotent replay.
Maya: language-specific hints?
Sam: python: requests + custom wrapper (urllib3 Retry is limited re: Retry-After). node: axios-retry + custom retryCondition. java: okhttp interceptor or resilience4j. Expose common config keys across SDKs: base_ms, max_ms, max_attempts, jitter_type ('full'), respect_retry_after (true), idempotency_helper (false).
Kevin: telemetry: increment retry counter per attempt, histogram of backoff durations, tag by status code and endpoint. Also log a single WARN when max retries hit so customers can surface rate issues.
Maya: thanks — I'll draft a PR for python defaults and README snippet. Jordana can take node. Sam will update the spec doc. If no objections I'll proceed with defaults: base=500ms, cap=8000ms, max_attempts=5, full jitter, respect_retry_after=true, idempotency_helper=opt-in.
CI Bot: linked PRs passed CI :thumbsup:
Maya: sounds good, I'll open the PR and reference this thread for rationale. If anyone strongly disagrees speak up before EOD. Thanks!
